item.title: Ore to Kanojo ga Mystery na Ken ni Tsuite
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: P.W.
  • 発売日: 2013-07-26
  • スコア: 6.18/10 (26 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 俺と彼女がミステリーな件について
  • 英語名: Ore to Kanojo ga Mystery na Ken ni Tsuite

あらすじ

This is the debut work for P.W., a sister brand to I.D..

Ayumu is able to see and hear things that other people can’t. He used to be bothered by it as a child, but now he has become used to it. When his father got a long-term overseas appointment, they sold the house expecting that he would naturally come along with them. However, Ayumu told them that he would rather stay in Japan. They relented only when they found him a place at his aunt’s apartment in the countryside where he had lived as a child.
